lines.zh: 我比同类更高，走路却有节奏。
lines.en: I am taller than my kin, and my walk keeps a rhythm.
Step by step, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 我杀过五个，才长成这样。
lines.en: I killed five before I grew into this.

lines.zh: 我的关节很长，步子很大。
lines.en: Long joints, long strides.
I walk toward whatever still moves.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，地面被踩实。
lines.en: The ground packs down where I pass.

lines.zh: 我抬头，脖子上的东西在动。
lines.en: I raise my head; something on my neck moves.
I walk the wall, looking for an entrance.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，因为这副身体值得。
lines.en: I walk steadily. This body is worth it.
I step over the fence.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声被自己的重量压住。
lines.en: My weight swallows my own footsteps.
I walk toward that house.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的东西在动。
lines.en: I stand, and things on me move.
I am no longer a zombie.

lines.zh: 我进化过一次，还会再进化。
lines.en: I have evolved once. I will again.
I am counting the living nearby.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比原来长了一段。
lines.en: My arms are longer than before.
I open my mouth; my jaw misaligns.
I can stand here the whole night through.
There are hard lumps under my skin.
I remember eating five.
I turn my head slowly, watching.
Warmth comes off you and drifts to me.
I stand here and let you move first.
I stand a head above you.
Your hands are already shaking.

lines.zh: 我记得自己也曾这样站着。
lines.en: I remember standing like that once.

lines.zh: 那时候我还不会想事情。
lines.en: Back then I could not think.
Now I know what to do.
Retreat. I will follow.
On this street there are only the two of us.
You are not thinking of running, are you.
That tore a patch of hide.

lines.zh: 被砸得一歪，我扶住了墙。
lines.en: The blow tilts me; I catch the wall.
Pain is a human matter. I am merely annoyed.

lines.zh: 我身上的硬块被打歪了。
lines.en: A hard lump on me was knocked askew.
One arm dropped slightly.
This will mend quickly.
Something other than flesh shows inside the tear.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在骨头上，没事。
lines.en: That one landed on bone, and did nothing.
I can still walk.
Hit me again, if you dare.
I do not touch dead things like that.
Cold meat is something I will not touch.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给已经变过的东西。
lines.en: You offer food to something already changed.
That mouthful will not fill me.
This smell has only just been spilled.
Leave the meat on the ground and back away three paces.
Only living blood runs hot enough.
This is too dry to bite.
Cooked food. I have no use for it.
I want only the one that still breathes.
You hit me and fell back.
I stood still. You bounced off.
Move. I am slow, but I do not go around.
The side you struck me with will bruise.

lines.zh: 我的皮很硬，下面还有别的。
lines.en: My hide is hard, and there is more beneath.
You charge in and stagger back two steps.
We trod the soil hard.

lines.zh: 别靠我的长手臂这么近。
lines.en: Not so close to these long arms.
I raise a hand, fingers spreading.
Push again. I am waiting.

lines.zh: 进化之后，这种事就没了。
lines.en: After evolving, that is gone.
I only want to evolve again.

lines.zh: 我的同类都还在下面一层。
lines.en: My kin are still a tier below.

lines.zh: 进化之后就没有这些了。
lines.en: After evolving, none of that is left.

lines.zh: 我连自己是什么都说不清。
lines.en: I cannot say what I am.

lines.zh: 这具身体里没有那个位置。
lines.en: There is no place for that in this body.
You ask like a living person.
I only remember eating five.
Get away from me.
I do not answer that kind of question.
I pick up a corpse.
I lift it to look.
Too light. Not enough weight.
One pull and it comes apart in my hands.
I keep this meat.
Something moves in my hand.
I press it into my body.
The taste is passable.
I throw the bones away.
I wipe my mouth.
You shifted your feet. Just what I want.
I have turned toward you.
Three strides is enough to bring you down.
Five fingers, spreading apart one by one.
You smell of sweat, and of iron.
The wall is at your back; you cannot retreat.
My shoulders have tensed.
First I will take your legs.
You did not run. Saves me trouble.
I stay silent and keep my breath for later.
I take a stride toward you.

lines.zh: 你退的那一步，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the step you just gave up.
This grab must be precise.
I am coming for you.
Your throat, just above the collar.
I am not fast, but every step brings me nearer.
You take one step; I take two.

lines.zh: 我会走到你停下的地方。
lines.en: I will walk to where you stop.
You round the wall; I round the wall.
I count the steps you have left.
I knock down a door.
You have gone upstairs.

lines.zh: 楼梯撑不住我，但我不想绕。
lines.en: The stairs may not hold, but I will not go around.
You changed direction again.

lines.zh: 你举着铁器，我数你的步子。
lines.en: You raise your iron; I count your steps.
A few more strides.
You have backed to the window.
The window will not stop me.

lines.zh: 你喘得急，我等最后一口。
lines.en: You breathe in gasps; I wait for the last one.
Your heartbeat, coming through a wall.
The last stretch.
My arms hang low; the fingertips move first.
If you stand still, I quicken.
My nails scrape across your armor.

lines.zh: 手够到你的时候，你还远。
lines.en: My hand reaches you while you are still distant.
This blow pins you down.
I catch your leg.
Blocked, but your feet are sliding.
My teeth sink into the meat of your shoulder.
I do not strike fast, but solidly.
You knock over the whole table.
One sweep of my arm.
I lift you up.
That should quiet you.

lines.zh: 你居然没倒，我停了半秒。
lines.en: You did not fall; I pause for half a second.
My left hand comes around from the side.
This swipe will lay you down for a long while.
I am beginning to feel hungry.
Another blow, heavier than the last.

lines.zh: 我从第五具尸体上站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the fifth corpse.

lines.zh: 我的身体比刚死时长了一截。
lines.en: My body has grown since I died.

lines.zh: 关节重新咬合，声音很响。
lines.en: The joints lock with a loud sound.

lines.zh: 我不再是普通的那一种了。
lines.en: I am no longer the ordinary kind.
I raise my head and see the night sky.
Around me are others not yet finished.

lines.zh: 我的手臂垂到膝盖下面。
lines.en: My arms hang below my knees.
I walk on the legs that just grew in.
Steadier than before.
I remember killing five.
That feeling is very clear.
Smoke rises far off; I head for it.
I will evolve once more.
This tier is only the beginning.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的皮，发出焦味。
lines.en: Fire scorches my hide; it smells burnt.
When I land, mud splashes up onto my shoulders.

lines.zh: 水灌进我身体，我往下沉。
lines.en: Water fills me and I sink.

lines.zh: 掀翻之后，我又撑起了膝盖。
lines.en: Flung down, I get my knees under me again.
Something is stuck in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 咒力在我体内乱走，很不好受。
lines.en: A curse wanders inside me. Unpleasant.
Too hungry. My strength is leaving.
Lightning passes through and I seize up.
The emptiness is deep. I fall a long time.
